lines.text: Many learners say: I am proud with my son.
Better: I am proud of my son.
Of! We are proud of you.

data.wrong: I am proud with my son.
data.right: I am proud of my son.

native.tip: После proud ставь “of”: “I am proud of my son.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am proud with my son”? 😅 По-русски «горжусь сыном» — без предлога, и хочется вставить “with”, а нужно “of.” Правильно: “I am proud of my son.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “of.” После proud — of. Скажи вслух: “I am proud of my son.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After proud, use “of”: “I am proud of my son.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I am proud with my son”? 😅 In Russian there is no small word, so “with” slips in, but English needs “of.” Correct: “I am proud of my son.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
